latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Assess whether a software architect is fulfilling the 8 core role expectations and has the right balance of technical breadth vs. depth.

- Evaluates architect performance using 8 core expectations from "Fundamentals of Software Architecture"
- Maps described activities and concerns to role expectations, highlighting gaps and strengths
- Assesses technical breadth versus depth using the knowledge pyramid model
- Designed to support self-assessment, peer evaluation, and transition guidance for new architects
- Provides targeted questions if required context is missing (current activities, concerns, career stage)
